body:
We should make efficient 3D model simulator for sound, we don't introduce any sound recordings, we simulate sound waves moving via actual 3D shape of human head.

We should keep only essential sound affecting details, make low poly model using blender or something, so we have both actual 3D view of sound simulation.

We can explore ideas from the internet, and as international phonetic alphabet actually gives ability to link exact mouth position with latters, we should be able to translate English, Russian, Hindi and Chinese to IPA, and generate smooth transitions between IPA symbols mapped to 3D model, which should work with or without visible animation of mouth.

Also we should be able to make an editor of human head and mouth proportions, so sound can be configured, and initially when users refreshes the page he gets random configuration, so it always sounds different.

We also should able to support multiple level of details, so sound wave simulation will work just fine even on slowest hardware. We should also have automatic adjustments to actual hardware, keeping always around 20% buffer from maximum performance, so if other system processes eat system resources we still perform nicely.

So we should be able to do only sound, only visual animation or both.

We need to do better that ever were done in this field and start optimizing for GPU/CPU on actuall web app, our GitHub WebPages would be primary UI, but we should be also available as library, CLI, local server API (including streaming), docker with server, and complete demo web app.

We should be using local development machine resources carefully, everything with intense computations should be kept on release testing or in CI/CD testing.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Initial prototype
